name: I-ne CO.,LTD.
summary: I-ne Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company that designs, develops, manufactures and sells beauty and personal care products, among them cosmetics and beauty appliances. Its categories run from haircare and skincare to beauty devices and eye makeup, sold under brands like BOTANIST, SALONIA, DROAS, Yolu, Tearal and CAROME, and it also manages retail outlets.
